role_1_tate_adelic_character_normalizati.statement: For local p-adic characters psi_p(x_p) = exp(i * tau * {x_p}_p) with tau = 2*pi, the partial-fraction decomposition q = sum_p {q}_p + n(q) (n(q) in Z) on Q subset A_Q uniquely forces the archimedean character psi_inf(x_inf) = exp(-i * tau * x_inf) (c_inf = tau = 2*pi) so that prod_{v <= inf} psi_v(q) = 1 for all q in Q.

role_2_poisson_opposite_grade_lattice_du.statement: Under f_hat(y) = int_R f(x) exp(-i * tau * x * y) dx, scaling the spatial lattice Z -> tau^K Z scales the dual lattice to tau^{-K} Z with covolume product tau^K * tau^{-K} = 1, supplying opposite-grade Poisson summation sum_{n in Z} f(n * tau^K) = tau^{-K} sum_{m in Z} f_hat(m * tau^{-K}).

role_3_grade_base_and_algebraic_exponent.statement: For K in A_R = Qbar intersect R, the grade action U_K f(x) = tau^{-K/2} f(tau^{-K} x) places prime-power stations at n * tau^K (additive log-shifts log n + K log tau). By Lindemann-Weierstrass + Gelfond-Schneider, tau = 2*pi is transcendental and hence tau^q is transcendental for every nonzero rational q in Q \ {0}; we do NOT assume transcendence of tau^K for irrational algebraic K in A_R \ Q (an open Schanuel-type problem), whereas density of Q in A_R and R already suffices for the spectral/analytic continuation steps.

role_4_canonical_theta_gaussian_exponent.statement: The self-dual Gaussian exp(-(tau/2) x^2) = exp(-pi x^2) has quadratic exponent tau/2 = pi tied to the Fourier kernel exp(-i tau x y), so P(D) = D^2 - 1/16 (D = t d/dt) simultaneously annihilates the s = 0 (origin) and s = 1 (integral) poles.

arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.arithmetic_grade_shift_p_tau_K: D_{p,K} f(x) = f(p^{-1} tau^{-K} x), log-coordinate translation u |-> u - log p - K log tau
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.analytic_prime_power_p_pow_tau_neg_K: A_K f(x) = f(x^{tau^{-K}}), log-coordinate scaling u |-> tau^{-K} u in Z_tau(s, K) = zeta(tau^{-K} s)
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.semidirect_intertwining_law: D_J A_K = A_K D_{J * tau^{-K}}  and  A_K D_J = D_{J * tau^K} A_K  (in log-shift parameter J)
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.zeta_operator_grade_sampling_identity: Z(U_{-K} f)(1) = sum_{n>=1} (U_{-K} f)(n) = tau^{K/2} sum_{n>=1} f(n * tau^K) = tau^{K/2} (Z f)(tau^K)

quotient_data_retention_classification.unquotiented_graded_monoid_M_Z: Retains individual prime factors p, exponents k, and grade index K in (n, K) -> n * tau^K.
quotient_data_retention_classification.divisor_aggregated_profile_W_log: Applies sum_{d|k} Lambda(d) = log k via harmonic aggregation sum_{m>=1} m^{-1/2} W(X/m), cancelling all zeta-zero poles in |Re(z)| < 5/2 while retaining integer stations k >= 2; exact Moebius inversion W(X) = sum_{m>=1} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m) recovers all prime-power weights Lambda(n).
quotient_data_retention_classification.meyer_cotangent_quotient_H_minus_0: Quotients H_- by Z(H_+ intersect H_-), annihilating the trivial integer lattice sum while retaining all nontrivial zeros rho of xi(s) with exact multiplicities ord_xi(rho) and all local prime Weil distributions W_p in the character trace formula.
quotient_data_retention_classification.connes_consani_sonin_compression: Compresses the theta map by the projection S onto Sonin's space (functions vanishing along  with their Fourier transform on (-2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2})), retaining the archimedean + p=2 semilocal trace on supp(g) subset [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] whileseparated grades |K - L| > log(2)/log(tau) extend support across all primes p >= 2.

connes_consani_moscovici_generator_ident.exact_ratio_identity: f_tau(x) = 8 * h_CCM(x)  and  x^{1/2} * Z(f_tau)(x) = 8 * k_CCM(x)

star_algebra_definition.algebra: C[A_R] generated by {V_K : K in A_R} with V_K V_J = V_{K+J}, V_0 = I, V_K^* = V_{-K}
star_algebra_definition.hilbert_realization: (U_K f)(x) = tau^{-K/2} f(tau^{-K} x) on L^2(R_+^x, dx/x) satisfies U_K^* = U_{-K}
star_algebra_definition.distinction_from_coordinate_conjugation: The star-involution V_K^* = V_{-K} is the Hilbert-space operator adjoint of unitary dilation U_K on L^2(R_+^x, dx/x), NOT complex conjugation of the real coordinate n * tau^K (which is already real and fixed by conjugation) and NOT unnormalized scaling f(tau^K x) (whose L^2 adjoint is tau^{-K} f(tau^{-K} x)).

character_compatibility_equivalence.star_compatibility_criterion: chi_rho(V_K^*) = conj(chi_rho(V_K))  <==>  tau^{-K * delta} = tau^{K * delta}  <==>  delta = Re(rho) - 1/2 = 0  (for any K != 0, since tau = 2*pi > 1).
character_compatibility_equivalence.hyperbolic_null_cone_explanation: Functional-equation symmetry rho <-> 1 - conj(rho) satisfies chi_{1-conj(rho)}(V_K) = conj(chi_rho(V_K^*)). For delta != 0, any V_K^* = V_{-K}-invariant Hermitian form B(., .) on span{e_rho, e_{1-conj(rho)}} satisfies B(e_rho, e_rho) = tau^{2 K delta} B(e_rho, e_rho) and B(e_{1-conj(rho)}, e_{1-conj(rho)}) = tau^{-2 K delta} B(e_{1-conj(rho)}, e_{1-conj(rho)}), forcing isotropic diagonal B_{11} = B_{22} = 0 and signature-(1, 1) hyperbolic quadratic form 2 Re(B_{12} conj(c_1) c_2) with eigenvalues +/- |B_{12}|.

multiplicity_and_jordan_socle_audit.socle_theorem_statement: By Meyer (arXiv:math/0412277 Cor. 4.2 & Thm. 5.8), each nontrivial zero rho of xi(s) with multiplicity m_rho = ord_xi(rho) >= 1 contributes the finite-dimensional generalized eigenspace E_rho = ker((^t D_- - rho)^{m_rho}) of dimension m_rho >= 1. Even if m_rho > 1 and ^t D_- has a non-trivial nilpotent Jordan part N_rho on E_rho, the socle ker(^t D_- - rho) subset E_rho has dimension >= 1, and any nonzero socle vector l_{rho,0} in ker(^t D_- - rho) \ {0} is a strict eigenvector satisfying U_K l_{rho,0} = tau^{K(rho - 1/2)} l_{rho,0}. Thus Target 1 requires only a positive inner product on the spectral realization (or on the socle) and never assumes simplicity of zeros.

meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.quotient_space: H_-^0 = H_- / Z(H_+ intersect H_-) (Meyer arXiv:math/0412277 Cor. 4.2)
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.spectrum_and_multiplicities: Spec(^t D_- | (H_-^0)') = {rho in C : xi(rho) = 0} with algebraic multiplicity dim ker((^t D_- - rho)^N) = ord_xi(rho) >= 1.
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.trace_formula_theorem_5_8: chi(rho)(f) = Tr(rho_-(f) | H_-^0) = sum_p W_p(f) + W_inf(f) = -W_xi(f) for admissible test functions f (Meyer Theorem 5.8).
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.ambient_L2_completion_obstruction: Completing H_-^0 in the ambient critical-line Hilbert norm ||[h]||_{L^2(1/2+iR)} (where ||[h]||^2 = (1/tau) int_{-infty}^infty |hat{h}(1/2+it)|^2 dt) makes U_K unitary, but off-critical point evaluation [h] |-> hat{h}(1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0) (delta_0 != 0) is unbounded in ||.||_{L^2(1/2+iR)} and therefore does NOT extend to the ambient L^2 completion.
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.convolution_trace_pairing_preservation: Equipping H_-^0 with the convolution-trace pairing <[g], [h]>_W := -chi(rho_-)(g * h^*) = W_xi(g * h^*) preserves every nontrivial zero rho of xi(s) (with multiplicity ord_xi(rho)) in the spectral expansion and makes U_K isometric because (U_K g) * (U_K h)^* = g * h^*.

connes_consani_2006_13771_compressed_sca.compressed_trace_identity_prop_2_2: Tr(theta(g * g^*) P P_hat) = int_{1/2}^2 (g * g^*)(rho) delta(rho) d^* rho for supp(g) subset [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] (arXiv:2006.13771 Prop. 2.2 & Appendix A).

separated_grade_support_extension.explanation: While a single compactly supported g in [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] has supp(g * g^*) subset (1/2, 2) (reaching only the archimedean place and p = 2 at the boundary), separated grade shifts h_{K-L} = (T_K psi_tau) * (T_L psi_tau)^* translate the center of mass to X_{K-L} = tau^{|K-L|}, crossing p = 2 at |K - L| = log(2)/log(tau) = 0.377146..., p = 3 at 0.597864..., and activating arbitrarily large primes p <= tau^{|K-L|} as |K - L| grows.

connes_consani_moscovici_2511_22755_zeta.operator_construction: Compresses the scaling generator D_0 = -i x d/dx to the finite-dimensional wavelet/prolate subspace QW_lambda(N) subset L^2([-lambda, lambda])_{ev} and applies the rank-one perturbation k_CCM = E(h_CCM) = (1/8) x^{1/2} psi_tau to obtain D_{lambda, N} with regularized determinant det_reg(D_{lambda, N} - z) = -i lambda^{-i z} hat{xi}_{lambda, N}(z) (Theorem 1.1 & Section 5).
connes_consani_moscovici_2511_22755_zeta.self_adjoint_vs_rank_one_perturbed_reali: Before the rank-one perturbation, the compressed scaling operator is self-adjoint with real spectrum (visual zeros on the real axis corresponding to Re(s) = 1/2). After the rank-one perturbation enforcing exact vanishing at the first N zeros of xi, D_{lambda, N} is a rank-one perturbation of a self-adjoint operator whose reality of spectrum is equivalent to those zeros lying on the critical line.
section_8_two_missing_steps: Step 1 (Irrational multi-prime alignment, arXiv:2511.22755 Section 8): Extend the caricature model (where log p are commensurable rational multiples of a single period so the Euler product collapses to a finite trigonometric polynomial with real zeros) to the actual incommensurable logarithms {log p} of distinct primes.

Step 2 (Inductive N -> N + 1 zero-location step, arXiv:2511.22755 Section 8): Prove that the high-accuracy real-axis visual zeros of the self-adjoint compression persist as genuine critical-line zeros as the cutoff dimension N and scaling parameter lambda -> infty.

positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.unitary_representation: U_K (phi, psi) := (U_K^B phi, T_K psi) for all K in A_R, where U_K^B and T_K are unitary dilations by tau^{-K} with U_K^* = U_{-K}.
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.hilbert_schmidt_seed_operator_B_0: B_0 := |Psi_0^pos><e_0| in HS(H_tau^pos), where Psi_0^pos := (A_tau^B psi_tau, 2 R_0 psi_tau) and e_0 is a fixed unit vector, with unitary orbit B_K := U_K B_0.
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.matrix_coefficient_identity: P_tau(K) := <B_K, B_0>_{HS} = <U_K Psi_0^pos, Psi_0^pos>_{H_tau^pos} = <A_tau^B T_K psi_tau, A_tau^B psi_tau>_{H_tau^B} + 4 <R_0 T_K psi_tau, R_0 psi_tau>_{L^2(d^x x)} = W_arch(h_K) + (c_tau^B + 2) h_0(tau^{|K|}) = W_arch(h_K) + c_tau^A h_0(tau^{|K|}).

exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.decomposition_formula: C_tau(K) = P_tau(K) + E_tau(K),   E_tau(K) = E_{tau,controlled}(K) - R_{mu,band}(tau^{|K|})
exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.controlled_remainder_formula: E_{tau,controlled}(K) = -(c_tau^B + 2) h_0(X_K) - W(X_K^{-1}) - W_log(X_K) - R_{mu,head}(X_K) - R_{mu,tail}(X_K),   X_K = tau^{|K|} >= 1
exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.large_grade_asymptotic_decay_of_E_tau_co: As |K| -> infty (X_K = tau^{|K|} -> infty): |(c_tau^B + 2) h_0(X_K)| = O(X_K^{-5/2}), |W(X_K^{-1})| = O(X_K^{-5/2}), |W_log(X_K)| = O(X_K^{-5/2}), |R_{mu,head}(X_K)| <= sum_{2<=m<=X_K/2} m^{-1/2} |W_log(X_K/m)| = O(X_K^{-1/2} log X_K), and |R_{mu,tail}(X_K)| <= 0.008568 X_K^{-5/8}; hence lim_{|K|->infty} E_{tau,controlled}(K) = 0 with rate O(|K| tau^{-|K|/2} + tau^{-5|K|/8}).

parallel_connes_consani_hilbert_schmidt_.half_line_projection_orbit_B_0_Sigma: B_0^Sigma := theta(tilde{psi}_tau)^* P P_hat in HS(L^2(R)_{ev}) gives P_tau^Sigma(K) = <U_K B_0^Sigma, B_0^Sigma>_{HS} = Tr(theta(h_K) P P_hat) and W_arch(h_K) = P_tau^Sigma(K) - D_tau(K), where D_tau(K) is the archimedean trace defect.
parallel_connes_consani_hilbert_schmidt_.sonin_projection_orbit_B_0_Sonin: B_0^Sonin := theta(tilde{psi}_tau)^* S in HS(L^2(R)_{ev}) (where S projects onto Sonin's space) gives P_tau^Sonin(K) = <U_K B_0^Sonin, B_0^Sonin>_{HS} = Tr(theta(h_K) S) and W_arch(h_K) = P_tau^Sonin(K) - E_{tau,prolate}(K).

remaining_open_obligation.exact_statement: Prove uniform boundedness sup_{X >= 1} |R_{mu,band}(X)| < infty of the localized resonant-band Moebius sum R_{mu,band}(X) = sum_{floor(X/2) < m <= M(X)} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m) (M(X) = floor(81 X^{5/4})), or equivalently construct a positive Hilbert-space inner product on Meyer's cotangent quotient H_-^0 for which the grade-translation representation U_K is unitary and the zero functionals l_{rho,0} are bounded.
